land.text: Nitra, driven out of by Mojmír I: 'Pribina was driven across the Danube by Mojmir, duke of the Moravians'

region.text: 'an independent polity which was centered on Nitra'

ledger.note: c. 825: Pribina rules an independent principality centred on Nitra. Infobox 'Independent state (825-833)', 'Established c. 825'; 'Pribina was initially the ruler of an independent polity which was centered on Nitra.' The page names the centre, not a boundary: the shape is Cliopatria's. The Nitra page only says the principality's centre was Nitra in the 9th century.

region.text: the principality of Nitra, 'conquered' by Mojmír I

ledger.note: c. 833: Mojmír I of Moravia expels Pribina and takes Nitra. Mojmír expelled 'one Pribina' across the Danube and Pribina 'fled to Ratpot who administered the March of Pannonia from around 833'; he 'conquered the neighbouring principality of Nitra' in the early 830s. Nitra page: 'In 833, Pribina was ousted by the Moravian prince Mojmír I'; both regions 'were united into the early medieval empire of Great Moravia'. Bowlus (Principality of Nitra page) holds Nitra was annexed only under Svatopluk. [Reviewer eu-15-a, 2026-10-25: source changed to the Nitra page, which has 'In 833, Pribina was ousted by the Moravian prince Mojmír I'; the Great Moravia page dates it only 'early 830s' / 'from around 833', and the quote 'Around 833, he expelled Pribina' is not on it]

region.text: Nitra, from now on Moravian land

ledger.note: 833: the independent principality ends. Infobox 'Independent state (825-833)'; Pribina 'driven across the Danube by Mojmir, duke of the Moravians' and fled to Radbod, margrave of Pannonia. The infobox's 'vassal of Great Moravia (833-906/907)' and 'incorporated c. 870' differ from the union reading.

wars.name: Mojmír I's conquest of Nitra
wars.outcome: Mojmír I drove Pribina out and united Nitra with Moravia, the beginning of Great Moravia ('Mojmir's forced unification gave rise to Great Moravia', Principality of Nitra page).
wars.note: No battle is described on any page opened; the date is 'around 833'. Pribina is recorded in the Principality of Nitra page as fleeing to Radbod, who held the March of Pannonia from c. 833.

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary; the principality is known by its centre at Nitra and the shape is Cliopatria's.

notes: Principality of Nitra, eu-15-a. Years 825-833 follow the infobox ('Independent state (825-833)'); Cliopatria's 814-839 is trimmed by verdict (shape unchanged). Pages disagree on what 833 meant: Great Moravia and Nitra pages say union after Pribina's exile; the infobox says vassal of Great Moravia from 833 and incorporated c. 870; Bowlus says annexed under Svatopluk. The dossier ends the independent state in 833 and the Great Moravia dossier gains the land the same year. The church Archbishop Adalram consecrated 'on his estate at a place over the Danube called Nitrava' is undated on the page (the Salzburg dating is not on it). Nitra 898-907 (the Moravian heir's appanage) is the separate dossier 'nitra'. Gazetteer: Nitra is a place; the region name is the admin1 'Nitriansky'.
